EITS-GCP-001.title: New service-account key used to set a project IAM policy
EITS-GCP-001.description: Correlate key creation with exact key-resource attribution for a subsequent project policy-setting API call.
EITS-GCP-001.exact_logic: sql/EITS-GCP-001.sql; same gcp.project; exact key path after prefixing //iam.googleapis.com/; 0 < elapsed <= 1800 seconds; successful CreateServiceAccountKey then Resource Manager SetIamPolicy
EITS-GCP-001.why_it_matters: A newly issued persistent credential quickly performs an access-control administration operation.
expected_false_positives: Authorized key rotation followed by deployment
EITS-GCP-001.tuning: Review exact key resource, project, policy delta and change authorization. No shipped exceptions; evaluate any proposed scoped and expiring exception against lost coverage.
limitations: Creation response.name may be omitted; rule requires it
Service-account key attribution is not universal
No alias resolution between project wildcards, emails and numeric account IDs
Only exact Resource Manager SetIamPolicy method
Delayed and simultaneous events are excluded
cannot_establish: A privilege grant or effective privilege increase
Persistence, lasting state or cross-cloud identity
EITS-GCP-001.observed: A successful key-creation record and later successful project SetIamPolicy record share the exact reported key resource name and log-owning project within 30 minutes.
EITS-GCP-001.inferred: Investigate possible credential misuse or unauthorized access-control administration; the API method alone does not establish a permission grant.

EITS-GCP-002.title: Public principal added to bucket object-access policy
EITS-GCP-002.description: Detect one successful bucket IAM policy change whose exact BindingDelta adds a public principal to an object-access role.
EITS-GCP-002.exact_logic: sql/EITS-GCP-002.sql; one delta contains ADD, allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers, and roles/storage.objectViewer, roles/storage.objectAdmin or roles/storage.admin
EITS-GCP-002.why_it_matters: Broad principals added to object-access policies may expose data outside its intended audience.
EITS-GCP-002.tuning: Review object classification, approved publication, policy history and public access prevention. Do not suppress on bucket-name keywords or broad actor identities.
limitations: Only the documented serviceData AuditData shape
Missing deltas, resource identity or status can cause misses
allAuthenticatedUsers is broad authenticated access, not anonymous access
Does not compute effective policy or constraints
cannot_establish: Malicious intent or lack of authorization
EITS-GCP-002.observed: A successful bucket policy-setting record contains an ADD delta granting an explicit object-access role to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.
EITS-GCP-002.inferred: Investigate a potentially unauthorized broad-access grant; publication intent and effective access remain unresolved.
